summary: Static Kotlin compile (android-34) + JVM unit tests for the four features: (1) RideParser meters/allMeters + Bolt heuristic, (2) RideOffer.withEstimatedTimes, (3) new VerdictSound synthesizer, (4) Settings (avgSpeedKmh + soundEnabled) wiring. All 36 JVM tests PASS (23 existing + 8 new RideParserEdgeCaseTest + 5 new VerdictSoundSynthesizeTest). Full kotlinc 1.9.22 compile of RideParser + ActiveNotification + GaugeView + OfferDisplay + OfferOverlay + VerdictSound + RideAccessibilityService against /tmp/p34/android-34/android.jar + androidx core 1.12 + kotlinx-coroutines 1.7.3 + Hilt stubs = EXIT 0, zero errors. Verified: VerdictSound.synthesize() buffer bounds are safe (total = sum(n_k + gap); max write index = offset_k + n_k - 1 < total — asserted explicitly in 5 new JVM tests on GREEN/ORANGE/RED/UNKNOWN + envelope). allMeters regex `(?<![\d.,])(\d+(?:[.,]\d{1,2})?)\s*m(?![a-zA-ZÀ-ÿ²])` correctly excludes 'min', 'm²', 'mai', and does NOT misread street numbers like '12 rue Mozart' as meters (dedicated tests cover each case). Bolt single-time + 2-distance heuristic routes the lone time to approach and leaves rideTimeMin null; RideAccessibilityService then calls parsed.withEstimatedTimes(settings.avgSpeedKmh) BEFORE engine.compute, so the overlay receives timeEstimated=true and OfferOverlay prepends '~' to the minutes (OfferOverlay.kt:214). Settings persistence wired end-to-end: VehicleSettings (defaults avgSpeedKmh=35.0, soundEnabled=true) <-> VehicleSettingsEntity <-> SettingsRepository mapping (both ways) <-> SettingsScreen Row/Switch/NumberField + save payload. AppDatabase.version = 3 with fallbackToDestructiveMigration (comment line 12). Service plays sound only when settings.soundEnabled is true, both in handleScreen (line 122) and showNextDemo (line 154), and sound.release() is called in shutdown(). No deprecated expo/react-native packages — this is a native Kotlin Android project.

critical_code_review_comments: RideParser.allMeters uses `(?<![\d.,])(\d+(?:[.,]\d{1,2})?)\s*m(?![a-zA-ZÀ-ÿ²])` — correctly rejects 'min', 'm²', month abbreviations ('mai'/'mars'), and address street numbers like '12 rue Mozart' (no 'm' immediately after the digit). Covered by 4 new regression tests.

RideParser Bolt heuristic (lines 105-107): when approachMin==rideMin==null, minFallback.size==1 and kmFallback.size>=2, the lone duration is assigned to approach — ride time stays null so RideOffer.withEstimatedTimes fills it from the ride distance. Correct behavior confirmed by `capture reelle Bolt` test (parsed.rideTimeMin is null; est.rideTimeMin ≈ 60.86 min at 35 km/h for 35.5 km).

RideOffer.withEstimatedTimes: short-circuits on avgSpeedKmh<=0 (returns `this` unchanged, timeEstimated stays false) — verified. Only fills missing values; present approachTimeMin is NOT overwritten. timeEstimated=true is set whenever ANY estimation occurs.

VerdictSound.synthesize: buffer size = sum(n_k + gap); the inner loop writes indices [offset .. offset+n-1], then offset += n+gap. Max written index = Σ_{k<last}(n_k+gap) + n_last - 1 = total - gap - 1 < total. No OOB. The trailing `gap` samples remain zero-filled (silence). Explicitly asserted in VerdictSoundSynthesizeTest.

VerdictSound uses USAGE_ASSISTANCE_NAVIGATION_GUIDANCE + AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN_TRANSIENT_MAY_DUCK + AudioTrack MODE_STATIC — correct ducking behavior like a GPS prompt. Playback executed on a single-thread Executor (never blocks the a11y binder). Executor shut down in release(), AudioTrack released in finally{}, focus abandoned in finally{}.

RideAccessibilityService: sound.play invoked AFTER overlay.show in both handleScreen (line 122) and showNextDemo (line 154); shutdown() calls both overlay.hide() and sound.release() — correct lifecycle. `by lazy` on both ensures no work on service construction.

AppDatabase version bumped to 3 with fallbackToDestructiveMigration — acceptable for a dev-grade settings table (loses user preferences on schema change but no cross-row data loss since VehicleSettings has a single row).
SettingsScreen imports Row/Column/Switch/Alignment are all present (lines 4,16,17,24) and the Switch is correctly inside a Row with Column(weight=1f) — layout compiles and renders.

Minor (non-blocking): fillFromFallback uses `values.filter { it != approach }` which, for exact float equality, is fine here because kmFallback/minFallback values come straight from the same regex captures (no arithmetic). If future refactors multiply/divide before the fallback, this exact-equality filter may miss. Acceptable today.

rca_of_issue: Aucun bug introduit par les 4 nouvelles features. Les quatre points demandés sont correctement implémentés : (1) le parser gère '135 m' sans faux positifs sur 'min'/'m²'/'mai'/adresses ; (2) withEstimatedTimes complète les durées manquantes à partir des distances et pose timeEstimated=true, consommé par OfferOverlay pour préfixer '~' ; (3) VerdictSound synthétise un PCM 16 bits mono avec bornes de buffer sûres, lecture via AudioTrack MODE_STATIC et audio focus transitoire (comportement guidage GPS) ; (4) les champs avgSpeedKmh + soundEnabled sont persistés via Room (AppDatabase v3) et exposés dans SettingsScreen.
